sloka: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ।वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ सुग्रीवः श्ङ्कितोऽभवत् ॥४-२-१॥
transliteration: tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ।vara āyudha dharau vīrau sugrīvaḥ śṅkito'bhavat ॥4-2-1॥

translations.english: On seeing the two great souls, heroic Rama and Lakshmana wielding the best of weapons, Sugriva was alarmed.
